name: Softrak Venture Investment Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Softrak Venture Investment Ltd is in the business of professional, technical, and business    services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is into information technology 
business and it provides customized 
software solutions build upon technologies 
 viz. Microsoft Asp.net, Java, JavaScript, 
PHP, Open Source, Android & IOS OS, 
My SQL, etc. Company's proposed 
customers include banks and other 
financial services firms, manufacturers, healthcare and life sciences organizations, Internet service and telecommunications providers, airlines, and transportation 
companies, educational institutions, 
and public-sector agencies

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 24.4%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 2.12% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 4,552 days.
